tasks.title: Confirm the static JSON tree is actually deployed and fetchable from the live Pages URL after a real deploy.
tasks.notes: FIRST DEPLOY MISSED THE TREE — diagnosed and fixed. The Pages deploy step runs `wrangler pages deploy site`, i.e. only the site/ directory is uploaded; the first commit placed the mirror at repo-root /static-data/, which was never deployed (live URLs returned the SPA fallback HTML; the updated app.js from the same deploy WAS live, proving the deploy itself worked). FIX: generator now writes site/static-data/; tree regenerated there (all 10 versions). VOICE demo tree also generated into site/static-data/voice/ from the STAGED bible-sources-staging/voice.sqlite3 via a temporary copy — voice.sqlite3 was NOT added to bible-sources/, so the original builds task-11 add-version demo staging is untouched and this triggered ZERO D1 writes. CI regeneration never deletes committed files, so the voice demo tree persists until task-11 properly adds voice.sqlite3 to bible-sources/.
